def tree(items,used,indent):
 if len(items)==1:return indent+f'return {items[0][0]};\n'
 # pick byte position maximizing distinct, tie earliest, represent beyond by ;
 poss=[]
 for pos in range(4,max(len(x) for _,x in items)+1):
  if pos in used:continue
  vals={x[pos] if pos<len(x) else 59 for _,x in items}
  if len(vals)>1:poss.append((-len(vals),pos))
 pos=min(poss)[1]
 g=defaultdict(list)
 for i,x in items:g[x[pos] if pos<len(x) else 59].append((i,x))
 out=indent+f'switch(p[{pos}]) {{\n'
 for ch,v in g.items():out+=indent+f'case {ch}:\n'+tree(v,used|{pos},indent+' ')
 out+=indent+'}\n'+indent+'return 0;\n'
 return out
with open('/work/stations4.h','w',encoding='utf8') as o:
 o.write('static const short idmap[4096] = {\n')
 seen=[]

  o.write(f'[{h}]={val},')
 o.write('\n};\nstatic const unsigned char lengths[413]={')
 o.write(','.join(map(str,map(len,ss))))
 o.write('};\nstatic inline unsigned resolve(const unsigned char*p,unsigned g){\nswitch(g){\n')

 o.write('}\nreturn 0;\n}\n')
 # names
 o.write('static const char *names[413] = {\n')

  s=x.decode().replace('\\','\\\\').replace('"','\\"');o.write('"'+s+'",\n')
 o.write('};\n')
